label: Long text
description: Multi-line plain text up to 10,000 characters, such as resolution notes, steps to reproduce, or an internal summary. No formatting is stored; line breaks are kept. Use rich_text when people need bold, lists, or links, and short_text for one-line values.
usage: Use for notes and explanations that people write in sentences.
Set maxLength to what a reader will actually read (2000–4000 is typical).
Pair with a workflow transition's requiredFields to demand notes at the right moment (e.g. resolution_notes on Resolve).
constraints: Values are trimmed at both ends; an empty string is stored as null.
Line breaks are normalized to \n; no markup is interpreted.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Multi-line input: Enter inserts a newline, Ctrl/Cmd+Enter commits an inline edit, Esc reverts.
accessibility.notes: aria-multiline=true; the remaining character count is announced politely when under 10% remains.

responsive: Full width of its grid cell; grows with content up to 12 lines, then scrolls.

spec.label: Resolution notes
spec.help: What fixed it, so the next agent can repeat it.
